title: Nearby Crafting Plus
description: Craft using items from nearby chests with a clean and intuitive system.
body:
This should be in Minecraft…

Nearby Crafting Plus

Craft using items from nearby chests without moving everything into your inventory.

Overview
Nearby Crafting Plus is a simple quality-of-life mod that lets you craft using items stored in nearby chests.

Instead of constantly moving items back and forth, you can craft directly from your storage while keeping the vanilla feel.

Features
Craft using items from nearby chests
Displays the maximum craftable amount
Quick “craft again” button
Lightweight and vanilla-friendly
How It Works
Place chests near your crafting table.

When you open the crafting interface, the mod automatically uses items from those chests as if they were in your inventory.

Requirements
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Notes
Designed to feel like a natural extension of Minecraft
No unnecessary changes or complexity
Support
The mod is free to use.
